name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native selective routing: Sol / High declares solo, delegate, audit, or exceptional full delivery before work begins.

interface.shortDescription: Plan with Sol / High, declare a risk-gated route, and use at most one auxiliary by default.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps the selected Sol / High primary session responsible for architecture, implementation when solo or audit is selected, verification and acceptance. Before the first task tool call it declares SELECTIVE ROUTE: solo is the default; in legacy, delegate uses native GPT-5.6 Luna / Max or GPT-5.6 Terra / High, and audit uses a fresh read-only GPT-5.6 Sol / High review; full combines one selected implementer with fresh review only for a broad or high-risk exception. Exact primary gpt-5.6-sol/high selects legacy; gpt-6.1-sol/high selects current with gpt-6-luna/max routine and separate gpt-6.1-sol/high complex and reviewer roles. Each invocation rechecks current-turn evidence, source and native role discovery. Missing or conflicting evidence fails closed; no cross-group fallback.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Use solo by default; select delegate, audit, or exceptional full only when the stated risk justifies it.
